body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> TDVISION Systems presented its wearable monitor 3D HMD (Head Mounted Display) during CES 2007. It is composed of a headset and a controller; if you connect the controller to pc, VCR, or DVD player, you can enjoy the content in 3D display with the headset.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo >
